note: Subsystem x lens. A wave takes a slice; the cursor advances so coverage is systematic rather than whatever an agent happened to think of. 9 x 8 = 72 cells.

subsystems.brief: The card career: shared/src/career.ts, shared/src/storyarcs/*, and renderCareer in client/src/main.ts. 120 turns, the loop the player spends most of their time in.
The match engine: shared/src/engine.ts, and the matchwrap screen in client/src/main.ts. Deterministic, tick-based, TICK_SEC 0.5.
The season and club layer: showSeason, spSeasonReward, the team talk, promotion/relegation, fixtures, the league table.
Succession and bloodline: api.succeed/bloodline/legends/houses, renderFamilyTree, the heir choice, legend cards.
shared/src/facilities.ts, contracts.ts, transfermarket.ts, morale.ts, and the squad lifecycle rollover.
client/src/save.ts, migrations, IndexedDB backend, slot management, and everything that has to survive a reload.
client/index.html — 2,065 lines of CSS and markup — plus every DOM write in main.ts.
client/src/audio.ts, the 12 MusicContext pools, stings, chimes, and every audio.play/sting call site.
shared/src/narrate.ts, storyarcs, commentary corpora, tier names, and all player-facing prose.

lenses.brief: Declared and never invoked; a check that cannot fail; a rule overridden into unreachability; a field written and never read; a branch no input can reach. THE HIGHEST-YIELD LENS ON THIS PROJECT — start here.
The code does not do what its name, comment or docs say. Off-by-one, wrong operand, inverted condition, a guard that lets the bad case through.
Something the player cannot understand, cannot find, or cannot undo. Silent failures. Actions with no feedback. Jargon leaking from the code into the UI.
Layout that breaks, overlap, contrast, text that overflows or truncates, animation that fights other animation, a state with no visual treatment at all.
prefers-reduced-motion, colour as the only signal, keyboard reachability, what a screen reader would announce, text size.
Repetition across a career or a dynasty, tone that breaks the game's voice, placeholder text that shipped, {TOKENS} left unfilled.
Work done per frame that need not be, layout thrash, O(n^2) over a growing list, assets loaded that are never shown.
Anything in shared/ that could vary between two runs of the same seed; save/reload divergence; ledger drift across generations.
